snippet.title: PACKFISH – Announcement Trailer | Cozy Fish Pack Opening Game | Out Dec 2 on Steam
snippet.description:
PACKFISH is a cozy pack-opening incremental game about collecting fish. Tear open packs, flip the cards and chase shiny Golden and Prism editions. Build living aquariums that earn while you're away, breed secret hybrids and complete a collection of 97 species. Just one more pack...

Out 2 December 2026 on Steam. Wishlist now:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/5497020

More Room Games on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/developer/RoomGames
